faq.q: o I have to purchase tickets in advance?
faq.a: Yes, tickets must be purchased in advance. Tours often sell out so we suggest purchasing your tickets early to guarantee your desired tour day. Tickets may be purchased through Fareharbor with a Visa, Mastercard or American Express.
